offering_description.value: Wholesale distributor of swimming pool supplies, equipment, chemicals and related outdoor living products. Sells to pool builders, remodelers, service professionals and retailers through a network of distribution centers. Also supplies irrigation and landscape products.

primary_products.value: pool chemicals; pool equipment (pumps, filters, heaters); pool cleaners; pool construction materials; irrigation and landscape products

customer_segment.value: B2B: pool builders, remodelers, pool service firms, retail pool stores, landscape contractors

end_markets.value: residential swimming pools; commercial pools; landscaping and irrigation; outdoor living

revenue_model.value: product sales: wholesale sales of pool supplies, equipment, chemicals and landscape products

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys from manufacturers and resells to pool builders, contractors and retailers, also private-label products

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Mexico, Europe, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: pool supplies, equipment, chemicals, irrigation and landscape products sold to similar contractor customers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: network of service and sales centers selling to trade customers; direct sales: sales representatives and delivery to pool professionals; online: online ordering platforms for trade customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: pool chemical handling and transport rules (EPA, DOT, OSHA), energy efficiency standards for pumps and heaters
